text:
ruth: starting staged rollout of serving-runtime v1.12.0 -> 15% eu-central. change window 13:00-15:00 UTC. keeping short probe.

deploy-bot: rollout_20260412_b2 initiated -> 15% (eu-central). Logs: https://infra.redwood/rollouts/rollout_20260412_b2

miguel: seeing p99 token latency spike +300ms on eu-central for completions route. no error increase.

ops-liz: KV client alarms show increased retry count on nodes serving canary. Could be backpressure.

ruth: pause please. `/rollouts pause rollout_20260412_b2`

deploy-bot: rollout_20260412_b2 -> PAUSED at 15% (operator: ruth).

release-manager: quick call: try config bump `kvcache.max_inflight=32` on canary, retest 5m. If latency stays high rollback.

miguel: applying config now to canary nodes. running short synthetic.

[5m later]
miguel: latency back near baseline after config tweak. propose resume at 5% and monitor 10m.

ops-liz: vote: :thumbsup: resume 5% with auto-pause thresholds.

ruth: resuming. `/rollouts resume rollout_20260412_b2 --percent 5`

deploy-bot: rollout_20260412_b2 -> RESUMED at 5%.

release-manager: status blurb ready: "Canary paused then resumed after KV tuning; monitoring." Will update status page.

ruth: thanks team. keep extra tracing on canary until this window closes.
